title: Illustrative total effort for one reviewed change
method: Synthetic equal-scope example. Manual total = 90 implementation + 30 review + 20 correction. Assisted total = 50 + 50 + 30. Excludes later maintenance; this arithmetic is not an empirical productivity claim.
alt: Illustrative total effort for one reviewed change. Manual path: 140 person-minutes, Assisted path: 130 person-minutes. Illustrative data.
